evidence.reason: The current workspace-member loop compares each member's package.json and only .npmrc/.yarnrc.yml/bunfig.toml, not a member-level pnpm-lock.yaml. pnpm supports shared-workspace-lockfile=false, which creates per-member lockfiles; a member lockfile can therefore select different dependency versions while root metadata and member manifests remain equal, causing dependency reuse to be accepted incorrectly. This is an existing dependency-reuse correctness bug, not a new protection requirement.
